primary_claim: The authors sketch a structured 'control safety case' argument, grounded in a five-phase black-box control evaluation (red team constructs adversarial model substitutes to attempt data exfiltration in a proxy deployment of ML engineering tasks, then extrapolate to a larger deployment), that could be used to justify that an LLM agent deployed internally at an AI company is incapable of exfiltrating sensitive data despite monitoring-based control measures.
quote: This safety case sketch is a step toward more concrete arguments that can be used to show dangerously capable LLM agents are safe to deploy.
